evidence_required: PostgreSQL normalization comparison for response, timeline, stored row, later read, and freshness projection
future-dated analysis and approval_input freshness regression output
observation text without state 422 and zero-write/zero-event evidence
FT-004 focused and full regression summaries
purpose: Restore truthful FT-004 accepted-input semantics so PostgreSQL, responses, freshness projections, and timeline evidence agree and user observation text is never silently lost.
success_outcome: FT-004 uses one canonical persisted pH/EC value on every surface, never marks future-dated measurements fresh, and rejects observation text without explicit state without writing false evidence.
anti_goals: No database schema or migration change.
No photo, Plant history, agent, Safety Gate, action task, follow-up, or PWA implementation.
No rewrite of historical TASK-019 or TASK-020 lifecycle/evidence.
No new timestamp-skew configuration or generic measurement framework.

forbidden_scope: photo, history, agent, Safety Gate, task, follow-up, or PWA behavior
stop_conditions: The repair requires changing PostgreSQL pH/EC column scales or a new migration.
The implementation cannot use one canonical value before result, freshness, and timeline construction.
The repair requires a public behavior not defined by the linked Plant Operations specs.
Diagnostics or evidence contain secrets, auth material, raw SQL errors, provider payloads, or hidden reasoning.

constraints: Normalize accepted finite in-range values with decimal ROUND_HALF_UP to pH scale 2 and EC scale 3 before ORM row, result, freshness, and timeline payload construction.
Freshness uses the closed interval computed_at - window <= measured_at <= computed_at; future-dated evidence is stale for both purposes.
Observation text without observation_state returns existing VALIDATION_FAILED and leaves no successful runtime or timeline write.
PostgreSQL/read model remains mutable authority; timeline remains audit/export only.
invariants: One measurement id has one numeric value across PostgreSQL, immediate response, later reads, freshness, and timeline summary.
Future evidence never qualifies as approval_input before computed_at.
Supplied observation text is persisted under explicit observed state or rejected; it is never discarded.
The repair does not authorize physical action or weaken ActorContext/Plant access checks.
verification_targets: Run the reproduced PostgreSQL excess-scale, future-date, and observation-state probes from the FT-004 feature red-verify report.
